svg.title: Single sign-on with OIDC and SAML — SoftTrack web design mockup (#309)
svg.desc: Sign-in is a password, or Google or GitHub, and an organisation with its own identity provider cannot use it. OpenID Connect comes first, configured with an issuer, a client id and a secret; accounts are created at first sign-in for listed domains; groups map to teams and roles; SAML follows; and an instance can require single sign-on, except for one named site admin.
svg.text: Single sign-on with OIDC and SAML
